source: UP Travel site-index listing-URL research snapshot
method: Website indexed listing URLs, using a topic-relevant listing search and a broad URL-term site index. Not a pagination scrape of the live directory, and not necessarily the full 104 directory cards.
upstreamReviewScope: First 12 card names, road labels and town strings independently observed in the waterfall directory. Other names are derived from site-owned URL slugs and are only provisional labels.
policies: Indexed URL does not establish current waterfall category membership, a safe visit, a landowner permission, or legal parking.
All source-only UP Travel records retain null latitude and longitude.
Town/road labels only available from twelve inspected directory cards; never geocode to an arrival.
No waterfall is added to visitor map, shortlist, or sitemap from this source snapshot.
Only previously verified first-page curated IDs count as known guide links; exact other names are candidate matches.
